summary: Makes release-note preflight wait deterministically for the dedicated labeler to converge a regenerated breaking Release Please pull request.

notes: This preflight-only correction does not change application data or migrations.

security: Only a canonical breaking heading on a same-repository Release Please branch activates the convergence wait.
Preflight continues to validate the actual release:breaking label rather than synthesizing a passing classification.
documentation: Release workflow contract coverage records the bounded convergence wait and actual-label requirement.
knownLimitations: Ordinary pull requests still rely exclusively on their explicit release label and conventional metadata.
rollback: Revert the preflight derivation and contract test, then rerun failed preflight workflows after generated release labels converge.
validation: Run the release-label workflow contracts, release-note preflight, and CI change-detection suite.
Regenerate a breaking Release Please pull request and verify first-attempt preflight success before label convergence completes.
